page.content:
Replicant blade runner of 2049.

How Officer K connects

  • Work: Blade Runner 2049 — 2049 is Officer K's investigation.
  • Faction: Blade Runners — K is a replicant blade runner of the Wallace era.
  • Faction: Replicants — K is himself a replicant.
  • Character: Joi — Joi stays with K as companion and witness.
  • Character: Niander Wallace — K's case runs against Wallace's hunt for the child.

What is Officer K?

Officer K is a Wallace-era replicant who retires his own kind, lives with Joi, and follows a buried skeleton into Deckard's secret.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner 2049, Blade Runners, Replicants, Joi and Niander Wallace.
